bio_en: Arshak Ghazarosian, known as Sebouh, was the son of a craftsman from Van, born in Constantinople in 1880. After the Central school he studied for four years at the medical school, intending to serve the cause as a government doctor in an Armenian province, and he twice went to prison for the party. After the 1905 attempt on the Sultan he joined the local committee directing ARF work in Constantinople; on 4 September 1905 he was seized by police on the Galata bridge while carrying a letter with important secrets and pseudonyms, and he died in prison, mourned by Droshak in September 1906.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Different person from General Sebouh (Arshak Nersisian).
